description: This Java source file defines a class named 'Grid' that represents a 2D rectangular mesh for graphics rendering, capable of being drawn textured or untextured. It contains methods for initializing the grid, setting vertex and texture coordinates, and drawing the grid using OpenGL ES 1.0.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: A class that models a 2D rectangular mesh for graphics rendering, with methods for initialization, setting vertex and texture coordinates, and rendering with OpenGL.

methods.name: Grid
methods.description: Constructor initializing the grid with specified width and height, allocating buffers, and constructing index data for rendering triangles.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the vertex position and texture coordinate at the specified grid point (i, j).

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the grid using the provided GL10 context, optionally enabling texturing.
